blocks.text: Good news for pizza lovers! Domino’s Pizza makes it easier—and more sulit—to enjoy more of your favorites with the NEW Picha Duo. With Domino’s Picha Duo, you can get 2 pizzas for only ₱579. Yes, ₱579 lang, 2 pizzas na! It’s a simple way to enjoy more pizza, whether you’re sharing with family and friends, bringing food to the office, or simply treating yourself to more of what you love. You can choose from Domino’s best-selling pizza flavors and enjoy two pizzas in one order.
